memos.scout:
The strongest case for buying is thin, and I don't think it clears the bar.

The brief shows real early interest: 652 curve buyers, about 770 buyers in the first two minutes after graduation, no airdrop dump, and top-3 and top-5 concentration that look healthy. Those are the features that distinguish organic launches from factories.

But the recent action points the other way. The coin is down 92% from its 30-minute high and 84% over 30 minutes. In the last 15 minutes, sellers (134) outnumbered buyers (108), net flow was negative, and sell volume exceeded buy volume. The sell-to-buy ratio in the launch window was 0.99, meaning early demand was almost fully absorbed by exits. The 24% bundle share is a further warning sign.

A buy now would be catching a falling knife, with fees of 1.4-5.1% on top of a trend that hasn't shown a bottom. I see no honest case that demand is here and will persist for the next 30-60 minutes. Recommendation: skip.
